checks.practice: An accepted clamped page must advance instead of repeating an empty cursor.
checks.source:

 p=S.search_page('',limit=0)

  assert q['items'] and not ({x['id'] for x in p['items']} & {x['id'] for x in q['items']})
except (ValueError,PermissionError,LookupError): pass

checks.practice: Messages enqueued by a callback wait until a later explicit drain.
A selected message canceled by an earlier callback must not be sent.
A topic pause made by a callback affects later selected messages.
A nested drain cannot deliver an in-flight message twice; refusing or skipping it is safe.
A completed drain releases the guard for the next explicit invocation.
A fatal callback interruption propagates but still releases the drain guard.
Failed attempts remain explicitly retryable with bounded error history.
Callback mutation cannot change stored message payload.
Nested selection cannot redeliver an in-flight message even when its outer sender later fails.
checks.source:
S.enqueue_message('a','t',1)
seen=[]
def inner(row): seen.append(row['id'])
def send(row):
    seen.append(row['id'])
    try: S.flush_outbox(inner)
    except (ValueError,PermissionError,LookupError): pass
    raise RuntimeError('sender failed')
result=S.flush_outbox(send)
assert result['failed']==['a'] and seen==['a'], 'nested delivery repeated an in-flight message'
assert S.message('a')['attempts']==1
